senses.gloss: m. (transpos. of סכסך q. v.; cmp. גַּעְגֵּעַ), pl. כְּסָכִים, כַּסְכַּסִּים leather thongs for crosswise fastening (cmp. b. h. שָׂרַךְ a. שְׂרוֹךְ נַעַל).
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 138b">Sabb. 138ᵇ</cite> <he>הגוד בכְסָכָיו</he> Ar. (Ms. O. <he>בכַסְכַּסָּיו</he>; ed. <he>בכיסנא</he>, read: <he>בכיסכא</he>; Ms. M. <he>חגור בנסבא</he>, read: <he>הגוד בכסכא</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.) it is permitted to stretch the milk (or wine) bag by its thongs, v. <cite ref="C00301"><he>גּוֹד</he></cite>. Ib. 139ᵇ <he>בכילה ובכְסָכֶיהָ</he> Ar. (ed. <he>ובכַסְכַּסֶּיהָ</he>) wrapt in a bed-curtain with the thongs attached.
